visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with medium-length dark hair, wearing a dark blue denim button-up shirt, stands at the entrance of a 7-Eleven store at night. He is speaking directly to the camera with a friendly expression. The background features a glass door and bright signage with Thai text and an "All Cafe" logo. (2) The scene shifts inside the brightly lit store where the man walks along an aisle with refrigerated display shelves. He points enthusiastically at various packaged sandwiches. He picks up a specific brown package labeled "Sausage Cheese Sandwich" and presents it clearly to the camera lens. (3) A close-up shot focuses on the hands of a store clerk wearing a green-and-white striped uniform. The clerk places two triangular pieces of sandwich into a professional stainless steel hot press machine. The clerk's torso is visible as they operate the equipment efficiently. (4) The clerk hands a warm brown paper bag to the man. The camera captures the man's face as he looks surprised and delighted, looking back at the camera. The background shows the interior of the convenience store with shelves of personal care products. (5) The man is now outdoors on a city street at night with soft background lighting. He carefully pulls the toasted sandwich out of the paper bag and takes a large, satisfying bite. He then holds the sandwich up to show the cross-section of cooked sausage and melted cheese. (6) In a continuation of the outdoor scene, the man continues to eat and review the sandwich. He uses his hands to emphasize his points while maintaining eye contact with the camera. The sandwich looks golden brown and crispy on the outside. (7) The video concludes with a graphic end screen featuring a white background, Traditional Chinese text inviting viewers to search for "Zhiqi Daily" on YouTube, and a small circular video insert showing the man in a different setting.
